title: Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: The satyr-king of the Skola Valley, a planeswalker whose spark ignited and who plots in secret, manipulating revelers with magic.

entities.name: Deiphon
entities.description: A young Meletian of a wealthy family and self-styled storyteller who visits the valley and is killed in Xenagos's revel.

entities.name: Kydele
entities.description: An oracle of Kruphix held captive by Xenagos, through whom Kruphix speaks.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A powerful planeswalker who hopes on Theros that the gods will keep her safe; Heliod believes she is destined to be his champion.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god of Theros, adored by Meletians, who believes Elspeth will be his champion.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the Sea of Theros, noted for precision.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: A goddess who immortalized Polukranos in Nyx and who believes Xenagos and the satyrs occupy the valley at her pleasure.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the Forge, absent from the night sky, who forged Purphoros's Sword and was said to have sided with Mogis.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: The God of Slaughter, said to plot to capture Heliod and keep him in the Temple of Malice.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A god who whispered to Heliod about Mogis's supposed plot.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God of Storms, whose lightning breaches Xenagos's vine-roof.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: The eldest and most inscrutable god, dwelling in the Temple of Mystery at the edge of the world, who speaks through his oracles.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: A god of the Underworld whose veil is compared to Kydele's hair.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A god served by priests, mentioned as a comparison.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: A massive hydra immortalized in Nyx by Nylea, unleashed by Purphoros's Sword, and said to have risen again.

entities.name: Purphoros's Sword
entities.description: A sword forged by Purphoros that set Polukranos free; later carried by wind into the ruins of Arixmethes.

entities.name: Callaphe the Mariner
entities.description: A sea-faring trickster of legend who steals trinkets from the gods; Deiphon says she has returned.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane ruled by gods from Nyx where history turns to myth quickly.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night sky realm of the gods, which materializes above the valley at sunset.

entities.name: Skola Valley
entities.description: An isolated valley of endless revels ruled by Xenagos, naturally infused with divine magic.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The walled polis, called the greatest city of all time, home of Deiphon and devoted to Heliod.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A polis whose people see Heliod and Purphoros differently from Meletians.

entities.name: The Nessian Forest
entities.description: A forest between Meletis and the Skola Valley, settled by Nylea above the bound hydra.

entities.name: Arixmethes
entities.description: A lost city in Thassa's ocean in whose ruins Purphoros's Sword was claimed.

entities.name: Kruphix's Tree
entities.description: Kruphix's seat at the waterfall at the edge of the world.

entities.name: The Underworld
entities.description: The afterlife to which Deiphon's soul is helped.

entities.name: Satyrs
entities.description: The revelers of the Skola Valley ruled by Xenagos.

events.summary: Xenagos, jaded satyr-king, broods over the revel and recalls how his spark ignited and showed him other worlds.
events.quote: But once his spark ignited, he'd seen beyond the boundaries of Theros, and everything he thought he knew had been shattered.

events.summary: Xenagos uses fiery magic to force the crowd to laugh uproariously at his jest.
events.quote: A fiery light flashed in his eyes, and the audience began to laugh uproariously at his jest.

events.summary: Xenagos casts a vine dome over the valley to block the gods' sight, wary of Nylea.
events.quote: a thicket of ethereal vines crawled over the valley and settled like a living dome above them all

events.summary: Xenagos ensnares three dancers with capture-magic and picks Deiphon to tell a god-story.
events.quote: But the young man was more interesting.

events.summary: Deiphon tells Xenagos that Callaphe the Mariner has returned.
events.quote: "Callaphe the Mariner has returned," Deiphon said triumphantly

events.summary: Deiphon tells the myth of how Purphoros's sword unleashed Polukranos and Heliod and Nylea bound the hydra.
events.quote: So in his destructive fury, he unleashed the mighty Polukranos from his home in the sky.

events.summary: Xenagos interrupts and mocks the god-story, breaching storytelling etiquette.
events.quote: "And blah, blah, blah, Kruphix slapped their hands and told them to never do it again or they'd be sealed into Nyx like bad children," Xenagos quipped.

events.summary: Deiphon reveals that the hydra has risen again, shocking the satyrs.
events.quote: "I heard that the hydra has risen again."

events.summary: Xenagos, enraged when Deiphon tries to leave, raises a red mist that compels the revelers to dance and gather stones.
events.quote: A red mist rose up out of the enchanted ground and shimmered around the legs of the revelers.

events.summary: Xenagos knocks Deiphon off the platform; entranced, Deiphon dances.
events.quote: Slamming his fist against Deiphon's skull, Xenagos knocked the young man off the edge and to the ground.

events.summary: The entranced satyrs stone Deiphon, who dies smiling and fatally wounded.
events.quote: Another joined in and then another, until the rocks rained down on him.

events.summary: Keranos's lightning breaches Xenagos's vine-roof, scattering the revelers.
events.quote: Keranos's strike breached Xenagos's protections and actually touched the ground

events.summary: Xenagos interrogates the oracle Kydele about the hydra, how to reach Nyx, and the edge of the world; she replies in riddles.
events.quote: "Is the hydra truly wandering among mortals?" Xenagos asked.

events.summary: Kydele warns that the gods know something is amiss and that soon everyone will know Xenagos's name.
events.quote: "Soon everyone will know your name," she said.

events.summary: Kydele helps Deiphon's soul pass to the Underworld and thanks Keranos for the lightning.
events.quote: "Thank you for the lightning, Keranos," the oracle said to the sky.

events.summary: Xenagos, weakened, lets Kydele transform into mist and escape toward Kruphix's Tree.
events.quote: so he did nothing as Kydele transformed into mist and vanished through the gap in the vine-roof

relations.note: Xenagos is satyr-king of the Skola Valley
relations.quote: Xenagos, the satyr-king of the Skola Valley

relations.note: Xenagos knocked Deiphon down and the entranced satyrs stoned him
relations.quote: Now that the damage was done, he wanted to prolong Deiphon's last moments.

relations.note: Xenagos hates Kruphix's oracles and fears Kruphix deciphering his plans
relations.quote: He should kill her now before Kruphix deciphered his plans.

relations.note: Kydele is one of Kruphix's oracles
relations.quote: That was typical of the oracles of Kruphix
Why was the God of Storms knocking on his roof?

relations.note: Nylea immortalized the hydra in Nyx
relations.quote: Nylea had immortalized him in Nyx

relations.note: Purphoros was jealous of Heliod and challenged him
relations.quote: He was jealous of Heliod and didn't want Nyx to reflect Heliod's glory.

relations.note: Heliod believes Elspeth is destined to be his champion
relations.quote: believes she is destined to be his champion
